cells.quote: Individual learners demonstrated moderate-to-large correlations between their gJOL and final test performance when learning individually, r (61) = .59, p < .001, as did Paired learners, r (86) = .60, p < .001.
cells.note: The study reports similar correlations but does not report a significance test comparing them; the reported contrast concerns relative metacognitive monitoring, not calibration.

cells.quote: Following the intervention, post-test scores increased significantly in all groups. The mean post-test scores were 13.3 ± 2.55 (control), 14.57 ± 1.64 (TJE), and 16.14 ± 1.72 (G-Jump). The G-Jump group achieved the highest mean score, followed by TJE and then the control group.
cells.note: Participants were randomly allocated after stratification by pre-test performance, but the text does not state that the pre-test represented prior knowledge of the target content.

cells.quote: Tukey’s post-hoc test indicated that in the post-test, G-Jump outperformed the control group (p = 0.0016), whereas other pairwise differences were non-significant.
